text:
Liam K: Thinking about doing a rooftop cookout + mini escape-room booking this Friday after hours (5:30pm). Short event — food, drinks, then a 45m escape room session nearby. Who's in? :grill: :key:
Maya R: omg yes. I can bring a small propane grill and some skewers. Need a veggie option?
Joel: count me in. Vegetarian here — can we do tofu skewers + a few salads? Also bringing a Bluetooth speaker.
Sophia: Love it. Heads up I'm allergic to peanuts so please no satay or peanut sauces.
Ankur: I'm in if it's not too late. Escape room — prefer earlier slot. 5:30 might cut it close for food + room.
Liam K: Good call. Thinking food at 5pm, escape room at 6:15. That gives time to eat and walk over (it's ~6 min).
EventBot: Poll created: https://polls.example.com/1773001234 — Options: Yes (bring plus-one), Yes (solo), Maybe, Can't make it
Maya R: Added a potluck doc: https://docs.example.com/s/picnic-items — please sign up for a dish.
Joel: Can we include a gluten-free option? My partner is GF.
Sophia: I'll bring a GF pasta salad. Also happy to volunteer to coordinate RSVPs.
Ankur: RSVP'd 'Yes (solo)'. I can handle booking the escape room — any preference for theme?
Liam K: Theme recs: 'Victorian Library' or 'Bank Heist'. Leaning Library. Thoughts?
Maya R: Library sounds fun and less intense :sweat_smile:
Joel: Library works for me.
Sophia: Library. Quick heads up — rooftop rules say music must be low after 9pm.
Liam K: Noted. Final plan: food at 5pm on rooftop, escape room (Victorian Library) at 6:15 (~45m), back by ~7:30 for hang. Meeting spot by the lobby at 4:55 for elevators. I'll post a calendar invite later. :calendar:
Joel: yay :party-parrot: I'll bring seating pads.
Maya R: Can someone paste the RSVP list here so I can plan food quantities?
Sophia: I'll DM Liam the headcount after the poll closes.
EventBot: Poll closed: 14 Yes, 5 Maybe, 3 No
Liam K: Awesome — looks like a go. I'll book the room and send invites. Thanks everyone! :tada:
